sources.snippet: multilingual-e5-small is an efficient multilingual text embedding model designed for cross-lingual semantic retrieval and vector search. Leveraging the BERT architecture for lightweight deployment, it supports high-concurrency inference, making it suitable for building multilingual knowledge bases, RAG systems, and semantic matching applications while balancing performance and resource efficiency.
